notes: Per-bucket maximum (4-year buckets, 1971-2022) of the public 50-year dataset 50yrs/*.dat at commit f2121ab2b83a156b114fe34e62e1edeca98e8e38, github.com/karlrupp/microprocessor-trend-data (CC-BY 4.0), which compiles Horowitz/Labonte/Shacham/Olukotun/Hammond/Batten data through 2010 and Rupp's additions through 2021. GPU and Xeon Phi records are excluded so that the frontiers describe CPUs; tied maxima use the later record. Fractional years are as in the dataset. Transistors are in thousands; single-thread performance is SpecINT x 1000; frequency is in MHz; CPU power is in W; logical hardware threads include SMT threads. Audited 2026-07-30.
